primitives.name: detect_dol
primitives.description: Identify the nearest prior swing extreme on the HTF in the direction of HTF structure. Returns a scalar price level.

primitives.name: detect_msu
primitives.description: Detect the current LTF market structure unit. Returns the current structure direction (bullish/bearish) and the most recent swing high and swing low.

primitives.name: detect_inducement
primitives.description: Identify the current inducement level. In a bearish MSU, this is the most recent lower high. In a bullish MSU, this is the most recent higher low. Returns a scalar price.

primitives.name: detect_sweep
primitives.description: Detect when the inducement level has been swept. Primary variant: wick through the level (bar high > inducement for bearish, bar low < inducement for bullish). Secondary variant: close through.

primitives.name: detect_csd
primitives.description: Detect CSD confirmation after inducement sweep. Evaluates Rule 1 (close > 50% of sweep candle) and Rule 2 (close > entire prior candle body). Either rule is sufficient. Body close only; wick excluded.

primitives.name: detect_fvg
primitives.description: Detect the Fair Value Gap created at or after the CSD confirmation sequence. Returns the FVG high and low boundaries.

primitives.name: detect_smt
primitives.description: Optional. Check whether the correlated instrument (MES) failed to confirm the new extreme at the inducement sweep bar. Uses a ±3 bar window.

primitives.name: entry_type_1
primitives.description: Entry Type 1: open of the candle immediately following the CSD confirmation candle.

primitives.name: entry_type_2
primitives.description: Entry Type 2: limit order at the FVG midpoint. Triggers if price retraces into the FVG after CSD confirmation.

primitives.name: compute_trade_management
primitives.description: Compute stop loss and target using the 3R fix. Stop = swept inducement level ± buffer. Target = entry ± 3 × |entry - stop|.

primitives.name: run_payout_vault_setup
primitives.description: Orchestrator. Runs all primitives in the correct sequential gate order. Returns a setup object if all gates pass, or a rejection reason if any gate fails.

pre_registered_hypotheses.hypothesis: The Payout Vault setup (DOL + MSU + inducement sweep + CSD confirmation) occurs with statistically meaningful frequency on MNQ 5m bars.
pre_registered_hypotheses.null_hypothesis: Setup frequency is not distinguishable from random structure breaks.

pre_registered_hypotheses.hypothesis: Entry Type 1 (next-candle) produces a positive expectancy on MNQ after realistic costs.
pre_registered_hypotheses.null_hypothesis: Entry Type 1 expectancy is zero or negative after costs.

pre_registered_hypotheses.hypothesis: CSD confirmation (vs MSS alone) improves win rate relative to entering on the MSS without waiting for CSD.
pre_registered_hypotheses.null_hypothesis: CSD confirmation does not improve win rate relative to MSS-only entry.

pre_registered_hypotheses.hypothesis: SMT divergence as an optional filter improves expectancy when present.
pre_registered_hypotheses.null_hypothesis: SMT divergence does not improve expectancy.

pre_registered_hypotheses.hypothesis: The setup is stable across the full dataset (2024-2026) and not concentrated in a single sub-period.
pre_registered_hypotheses.null_hypothesis: Setup performance is concentrated in one sub-period and not stable.
pre_registered_hypotheses.evaluation_period: Full dataset split into 4 equal sub-periods

experiment_plan.name: Baseline frequency and setup detection
experiment_plan.description: Run run_payout_vault_setup() on the full dataset with default parameters. Count setups, measure frequency, record rejection reasons.

experiment_plan.name: Entry Type 1 backtest — baseline
experiment_plan.description: Backtest Entry Type 1 with default config. Report: trade count, win rate, PF, expectancy, max DD, Sharpe.

experiment_plan.name: CSD vs MSS-only comparison
experiment_plan.description: Run a parallel backtest using MSS-only entry (no CSD gate) and compare metrics to EXP-02.

experiment_plan.name: CSD window sensitivity
experiment_plan.description: Run EXP-02 with csd-window-1, csd-window-3, and csd-window-10. Report results separately.

experiment_plan.name: Stop buffer sensitivity
experiment_plan.description: Run EXP-02 with stop-1tick and stop-4tick. Report results separately.

experiment_plan.name: SMT divergence filter
experiment_plan.description: Run EXP-02 with SMT enabled. Compare expectancy of SMT-confirmed setups vs all setups.

experiment_plan.name: Sub-period stability
experiment_plan.description: Split the full dataset into 4 equal sub-periods and run EXP-02 on each. Report metrics per sub-period.

experiment_plan.name: Entry Type 2 backtest
experiment_plan.description: Backtest Entry Type 2 (FVG retracement) with default config. Compare to EXP-02.
